findings.source_quote: But, by now, most of what is known locally as “the spring work” has been finished.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted phrase into Kiswahili idiomatically and preserve the quotation marks. For example: “kazi ya msimu wa machipuko”. Replace the phrase “kazi ya spring” with “kazi ya msimu wa machipuko” so the sentence reads naturally and the quoted local expression is rendered in the target language.
findings.translation_quote: Lakini, hadi sasa, kazi inayojulikana kwa ndani kama “kazi ya spring” imemalizika.

findings.source_quote: Something new in this issue is the beginning of a series by Brother Donald Brechbill on “discipleship”. Disciple has almost the same spelling as discipline.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English terms into Kiswahili rather than leaving them in English. Suggested rendering: “kuzaliwa kwa mfululizo kuhusu ‘ufundishaji wa wanafunzi’ (discipleship). Neno ‘wanafunzi’ lina takriban tahajia ile ile na neno ‘nidhamu’ (discipline).” Or simply: “... mfululizo kuhusu ‘ufundishaji wa wanafunzi’. Neno ‘wanafunzi’ lina takriban tahajia ile ile na neno ‘nidhamu’.” Preserve the quotation marks around the quoted term as in the source.
findings.translation_quote: Kitu kipya katika toleo hili ni kuanza kwa mfululizo wa Ndugu Donald Brechbill juu ya “ufanyaji wa wanafunzi” (discipleship). Neno disciple lina takriban tahajia ile ile na discipline.

findings.source_quote: For many, discipline carries a negative connotation, which hopefully will not interfere with the reader being drawn to what Brother Donald has to share.
findings.suggested_fix: The Kiswahili translation uses the verb “haitasisitiza” which changes the intended sense. Use a verb conveying 'prevent' or 'deter' such as “haitazuia” or the phrase “si itakuwazuia”. Suggested fix: replace “ambayo kwa matumaini haitasisitiza msomaji kuvutwa...” with “ambayo, kwa matumaini, haitazuia msomaji kuvutwa...”.
findings.translation_quote: Kwa wengi, nidhamu ina maana hasi, ambayo kwa matumaini haitasisitiza msomaji kuvutwa na kile Ndugu Donald anachotaka kushiriki.
